title: RGChatMention
description: Lightweight configurable chat mention plugin for Paper and Spigot with @player and @everyone support.
body:
## RGChatMention

RGChatMention is a lightweight, configurable chat mention plugin for Minecraft servers running Paper or Spigot.

It allows players to mention others using `@player` and notify all online players using `@everyone`. Mentioned players receive a sound notification and see their name highlighted in chat, making important messages easier to notice during gameplay.

The plugin is designed to remain efficient and performance-friendly while giving server owners full control through a simple configuration system.

---

## Features

- Mention players using `@player`
- Notify all players using `@everyone`
- Highlighted chat formatting for mentions
- Fully configurable colors and formatting
- Adjustable sounds (volume and pitch)
- Permission-based access control
- Reload configuration without restarting
- Lightweight and optimized
- No external dependencies required

---

## Commands

/rgmention reload
Reloads the plugin configuration without restarting the server.

---

## Permissions

rgmention.use
Allows players to use `@player`

rgmention.everyone
Allows players to use `@everyone` (OP by default)

---

## Configuration

Upon first launch, the plugin generates a `config.yml` file.

Server owners can:

- Enable or disable player mentions
- Enable or disable everyone mentions
- Customize mention colors and formatting
- Adjust sound, volume, and pitch

Changes can be applied instantly using the reload command.

---

## Compatibility

- Server software: Paper, Spigot
- Minecraft version: 1.20+
- Java version: 17+

---

## Notes

- No external downloads
- No license key or online activation
- Developed and maintained by RG Studios
